paper_title: A题-1-通用神经网络处理器下的核内调度问题

argumentation_roles.lesson: use a compact architecture or flow diagram to establish DAG, cache hierarchy and three-question dependency before mathematical detail
plot Vstay across schedule steps for every workload family with the same semantic axes; peak marker must be sourced from the result registry
show current/best objective trajectories only when plotted values can be machine-reconciled with the textual start/final values and final table
paired utilization bar + allocation-share pie can separate capacity utilization from allocation composition; captions must name which metric each panel means
Q3 should emphasize a feasibility/trade-off table or Pareto view, explicitly flagging workloads that worsen or violate the 1.05 transfer cap rather than hiding them in an average

style_observations: Vstay plots use light filled area under a thin line, with a red peak marker and compact highlighted Max label
SA convergence uses one current-cost line and a dashed best-cost line with grid and a small legend
Q2 cache analysis pairs a per-cache utilization bar chart with an allocation-share pie chart for each workload
tables use sparse horizontal-rule academic typesetting; no decorative 3D charts
visual_contract_issue: Figure 5.7 pixel values and the following 14000→7760 paragraph are inconsistent; future plots must be generated from the same result registry as narrative/table values.
